savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_12379 (EO 12379, 47 FR 36099-36100, read once in full): secs. 1-23 revoke 23 orders by number, secs. 24-25 terminate two committees, and nothing in the 25 sections saves, continues, transfers or excepts anything; sec. 9 revokes EO 12262 without qualification. Own-residual check, reading EO 12262 in full: it set up a coordinating Council of agency heads (1-101 to 1-104), gave it coordination, policy, information and evaluation functions (1-2) and administrative provisions (1-3: quarterly meetings, agency cooperation, Labor Department support, working groups) and an annual summary report to the President (1-207). It conferred no right or benefit on any person, transferred no function, property or funds, and fixed no duty that outlives the Council; reports already made are completed acts. Its recital that it 'continue[s] the improvements made by Reorganization Plan No. 4 of 1978' refers to a statutory plan that EO 12379 does not touch. The U.S. Code note at 29 U.S.C. 1001 note records the revocation and no saving. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) KEPT. Bounded search: EO 12262 and EO 12379 in full.

research_rationale: EO 12262 (signed January 7, 1981; 46 FR 2313-2314), read in full from the held FR text, created the Interagency Employee Benefit Council with no term or sunset. EO 12379 (signed August 17, 1982; 47 FR 36099-36100), read in full from the held FR text, revokes it by number in sec. 9 and states no effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing. The dossier's clause segmentation was incomplete (its last item absorbed secs. 1-104 through 1-304), so I replaced it with 15 section-level scopes covering every operative paragraph; the authority recital and the 'ordered as follows' lead are not separately inventoried because they carry no command. Earlier-end test: no amendment, supersession or earlier revocation appears in the OFR catalog hits (2), the U.S. Code and eCFR hits (2 each, the 29 U.S.C. 1001 note naming EO 12379 sec. 9 as the revoking act) or the dossier chain; its member the President's Commission on Pension Policy was revoked by EO 12379 sec. 1 the same day, which does not end the Council earlier. Savings: see savings_residuals; the prefill was confirmed, not copied.
